other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana State
Pilgrim must complete the Yatra through the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India and obtain a completion certificate from the Ministry
Financial assistance is provided only once to a pilgrim
Application must be submitted within two months after completion of the Yatra
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹50,000 or 50% of actual expenditure (whichever is less) for up to 50 pilgrims.
documents_required: Completion certificate from Ministry of External Affairs
